mapper.select: SELECT * FROM TBL_VOUCHER_UNPOST_RECORD WHERE VOUCHER_ID = #{voucherId} AND IS_DELETED = 0 ORDER BY UNPOST_TIME DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TBL_VOUCHER_UNPOST_RECORD ( RECORD_ID, VOUCHER_ID, VOUCHER_NO, VOUCHER_TYPE, TOTAL_AMOUNT, POSTING_TIME, POSTING_BY, POSTING_BY_NAME, UNPOST_REASON, UNPOST_TIME, UNPOST_BY, UNPOST_BY_NAME, UNPOST_STATUS, BOOK_ID, TENANT_ID, REMARK, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_TIME, IS_DELETED ) VALUES ( SEQ_VOUCHER_UNPOST_RECORD.NEXTVAL, #{record.voucherId}, #{record.voucherNo}, #{record.voucherType}, #{record.totalAmount}, #{record.postingTime}, #{record.postingBy}, #{record.postingByName}, #{record.unpostReason}, SYSDATE, #{record.unpostBy}, #{record.unpostByName}, 'UNPOSTED', #{record.bookId}, #{record.tenantId}, #{record.remark}, SYSDATE, SYSDATE, 0 )
mapper.update: UPDATE TBL_VOUCHER_UNPOST_RECORD SET UNPOST_STATUS = #{status}, REPOST_TIME = SYSDATE, REPOST_BY = #{repostBy}, REPOST_BY_NAME = #{repostByName}, UPDATE_TIME = SYSDATE WHERE RECORD_ID = #{recordId}
